info.title: Compass API
info.description: Backend for Compass (Rutgers Health Hack 2026). Turns Wellness Inventory scores into one next step, follows up, and feeds Staff Pulse. All data in this prototype is synthetic or labelled sample unless marked otherwise. Auth: POST /demo/session, then `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Every response carries `synthetic` and the simulated `now`. Header `X-Compass-Fallback: fixture|template` marks fallbacks.
